6.375 rsConflictingNaturalGroupRequirements
Applies to RDL 2011/01
rsConflictingNaturalGroupRequirements is a critical error that occurs when two or more groupings
associated with a DataSet describe conflicting NaturalGroup requirements. A grouping without an
ancestor/descendent relationship associated with the same dataset can use NaturalGroup only if
they define the same sequence of GroupExpression.
